required.name: python3
required.why: run lib/schedule.py — the deterministic wave scheduler / cycle detector

optional.name: atlassian
optional.why: read the epic + every child ticket (status, assignee, dependencies)
optional.install: connect the Atlassian MCP or use the acli CLI
optional.degrade: ask the user to paste the epic's tickets, statuses, and dependencies

optional.name: defuddle
optional.why: read linked PRD / design / cross-repo Confluence pages for un-provided dimensions
optional.degrade: use acli confluence page view, or ask the user to paste the docs

optional.name: glab
optional.why: verify a ticket is actually merged (not just marked Done) before advancing a wave
optional.degrade: rely on Jira status + the user's explicit done signal

optional.name: gh
optional.why: verify GitHub PR merge state before advancing a wave
optional.degrade: rely on Jira status + the user's explicit done signal

optional.name: hindsight
optional.why: recall prior decisions about this epic / domain
